service.method: WITH DATA AS (SELECT COMPANY_NAME_LOC TEXT , HOUSE_CODE||'_'||COMPANY_CODE ID , COMPANY_CODE CODE , HOUSE_CODE PARENTID , 'COMPANY' TYPE FROM SCMGL UNION ALL SELECT PLANT_NAME_LOC , HOUSE_CODE||'_'||COMPANY_CODE||'_'||PLANT_CODE , PLANT_CODE , HOUSE_CODE||'_'||COMPANY_CODE , 'PLANT' FROM SPLNT UNION ALL SELECT STORAGE_NAME_LOC , HOUSE_CODE||'_'||COMPANY_CODE||'_'||PLANT_CODE||'_'||STORAGE_CODE , STORAGE_CODE , HOUSE_CODE||'_'||COMPANY_CODE||'_'||PLANT_CODE , 'STORAGE' FROM SSTRG ) , LINKED AS (SELECT TEXT , ID , CODE , PARENTID , TYPE FROM DATA START WITH PARENTID = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} CONNECT BY PRIOR ID = PARENTID ) SELECT TEXT , ID , CODE , PARENTID , TYPE FROM LINKED WHERE( 1 = 1 AND TEXT LIKE '%'|| $S{F_KEYWORD} ||'%' OR CODE LIKE '%'|| $S{F_KEYWORD} ||'%' ) ORDER BY ID
